sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze: the enclosedByPlatedBossing path is applied to any shipComponent reached by hasComponent and is not linked to the actual side-propeller shafting and stern-tube nodes. Preserve the required ship-to-shipComponent owner path, but constrain the component values identified by hasSidePropellerShafting and hasSternTube so that each applicable component is enclosedByPlatedBossing; do not satisfy the requirement with an unrelated component.
